qualification:
Extend the complete unseeded native caller's byte-frame postconditions.
No callee or caller operation is changed; observe original allocations directly.
domain: All unseeded native predecessor inputs retained. Only the already existing arbitrary checkpoint coordinate is queried additionally before the unchanged native source call; successful calls keep their exact output-byte assertion and returned errors must preserve this original byte. No new large proof/public coordinate query. The whole caller, all original assertions, arbitrary Rc counts, metadata, buffers and rejection branches remain.
retained: Same fixed lengths, common successful child replies, pure scan overapproximation, canonical data/lamport slot model, runtime heap embedding, actual child identities, and ordered state/log/oracle transport. Not a total native-to-owned or whole S2 closure.
